hook: A 100-dollar watch can be 99.99 percent accurate.
hookText: A 100-dollar watch can be 99.99 percent accurate.

beats.say: Mechanical watches have kept time for 500 years, and this interactive 3D page explains how a modern one works.
The author calls it fascinating that a well-calibrated, purely mechanical device can keep time with 99.99 percent accuracy for 100 dollars.
The gear math checks out: the third wheel runs 7 and a half times slower, and the center wheel 8 times slower than that, so 7 and a half times 8 is 60, and the center wheel turns once an hour.
